html:
Alabaster Dawn is an Action RPG building on top of the best aspects of Radical Fish Games' previous title CrossCode, featuring a deep and engaging combat system, challenging puzzles and an epic story set in a curious world full of secrets to discover and places to explore.

The shadow of Nyx has fallen, warping the world into a wasteland and vanishing the gods and their people. Now, Juno, the Outcast Chosen, awakens to an impossible task: bring it all back.

Demo Content


This demo version features two parts

The first part will feature the actual beginning of the game. Any saves made within this part will be compatible with the full game.

The second part will skip ahead in the story to showcase several highlights including a part of a dungeon. Any saves within this part will be reset back to the end of the first part when loaded in the full game, so you won’t miss any of the skipped content.

Overall this demo version features:
* A playtime of around 1.5 - 2.5 hours
* 2 melee weapons and 2 range weapons
* 9 enemy types
* 4 boss enemies
